_notes.summary: Specification for all campaign slash commands. Defines parameters, permission gates, output type, and expected bot response for each command. Channel restrictions use the existing allowed_command_channel_ids list in config.json — no campaign-specific channel overrides needed unless the Forgemaster adds them.

output_types.ephemeral: Visible only to the invoking user. Used for all personal and operational views to avoid channel spam.
output_types.persistent: Bot posts or edits a persistent embed in the channel. Used only for the campaign dashboard.

_notes.permission_model: Commands gate on Discord roles. Role names match rank_mappings.json canonical names. 'Any enlisted' = any user with the Enlisted role granted at /campaign-enlist.
_notes.channel_config: Campaign commands are allowed in the same channels as existing bot commands (config.json allowed_command_channel_ids). Forgemaster can add a dedicated campaign channel to that list. Dashboard command posts to whatever channel it is invoked in — choose a pinned campaign channel.
_notes.command_lock: During beat resolution (between closes_at and resolved_at), /campaign-log is blocked. All other commands remain available but show a 'Beat evaluating — results pending' notice if data is stale.
_notes.naming_convention: All campaign commands use the /campaign- prefix. This avoids collision with existing bot commands.

commands.name: /campaign-enlist
commands.description: Enlist yourself in the current campaign. Assigns the Enlisted role, registers your chapter and company/KT assignment, and opens cascade participation.
commands.who_can_use: Any server member with a campaign-eligible rank role

parameters.name: company
parameters.type: string (choice: primus | secundus | tertius | quartus | quintus)
parameters.required: required for Company-tier and KT-tier roles; optional for HC-tier (derived from operational attachment)
parameters.description: Which Watch Company you are assigned to.

parameters.name: kill_team_sgt
parameters.required: required for KT-tier roles; omit for Company-tier and HC-tier
parameters.description: The Watch Sergeant whose kill team you belong to.

commands.bot_response: Confirms enlistment with your role, chapter, company, and KT. Posts a welcome embed showing your cascade window timing and which milestone sets are active for your chapter.
constraints: Can only enlist while campaign phase is seeding, cascade_*, or ops (not evaluating or complete).
If already enlisted and active, returns an error — use /campaign-de-enlist first.
If re-enlisting after auto-de-enlist, creates a fresh record.

commands.name: /campaign-de-enlist
commands.description: Voluntarily de-enlist from the current campaign. Removes the Enlisted role and marks your cascade slot as vacant. Milestone progress is retained in case of re-enlistment.
commands.bot_response: Confirms de-enlistment. Notes that milestone progress is saved and can be resumed if they re-enlist before campaign end.

auto_de_enlist.trigger: 28 days with no qualifying AAR (hard_strat or omega) where member appears in brother_ids
auto_de_enlist.warning: Bot DMs the member at 21 days of inactivity (auto_de_enlist_warning_sent = true).
auto_de_enlist.action: At 28 days: sets active = false, removes Enlisted role, marks cascade slot vacant. Does not delete milestone_progress.
auto_de_enlist.note: Auto-de-enlist check runs nightly as a scheduled job.

commands.name: /campaign-log
commands.description: Submit a campaign log entry for an op you completed. Links to your most recent qualifying AAR. Bot infers beat, mission, planet, difficulty, and boss identity from the matched AAR. You only provide what the AAR cannot tell the bot.

parameters.name: terminus_killed
parameters.description: Was any terminus target killed during this op? (roaming or fixed boss)

parameters.name: strats_active
parameters.type: string (comma-separated stratagem names, autocomplete from campaign strat pool)
parameters.description: Which stratagems were active this run. Leave blank if none or if Siege (strats not permitted on Op 14).

parameters.name: aar_ref
parameters.description: Optionally link directly to your AAR record. If omitted, bot matches by member ID + closest timestamp.

commands.bot_response: Confirms the log entry with all bot-inferred fields displayed: mission name, planet, difficulty, beat, boss identity (if fixed-boss mission and terminus_killed = true). Shows prestige breakdown awarded. If strats submitted don't include all mandated strats, shows a mandate compliance warning (not a block).
constraints: Blocked during beat resolution window (closes_at to resolved_at).
Blocked if campaign phase is evaluating or complete.
One log entry per AAR — bot checks aar_ref or timestamp proximity. Duplicate within 15-minute window of same member = rejected with guidance.
Bot warns (does not block) if strats_active conflicts with published mandate or conflict_map.

commands.name: /campaign-orders
commands.description: View your current orders for this beat. Output is rank-dependent — each tier sees a different embed tailored to their authority and responsibilities.

bot_response._note: Bot determines the member's tier from their enlistment record and renders the appropriate embed.
bot_response.HC_tier: Strategic overview: committed planet, current pressure, theatre strat mandate, terminus flag, current campaign phase and beat. Lists all companies and their prestige standings. Shows lore priority KT and company.
bot_response.Company_tier: Company view: company name + title, company prestige vs other companies, all KTs in the company with their prestige and KT strat mandates. Shows Company Champion's terminus call if set.
bot_response.KT_Sergeant: Kill team view: KT name + title, KT prestige, full mandate (theatre + company + KT strat), prestige mission status (designated mission and whether run this beat), list of KT members with their individual prestige contributions this beat.
bot_response.KT_battleline_and_specialists: Personal view: your company, your KT, personal prestige this beat and campaign total, all three active mandate strats, active milestone progress bars for your chapter's applicable milestones.

commands.name: /campaign-prestige
commands.description: View the rolling 28-day prestige standings for kill teams and companies.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.default: kill_team for KT-tier members, company for Company/HC-tier members
parameters.description: Whether to show KT standings or company standings.

commands.bot_response: Ranked list of all active KTs (or companies) by rolling prestige. Shows current ribbon/title/honour for each. Highlights the invoker's own KT/company. Notes lore priority holder. Shows prestige floor status for each reward tier.

commands.name: /campaign-mandate
commands.description: View the published strat mandate for the current beat. Shows all three mandate tiers and which strats are required.
commands.bot_response: Displays theatre mandate (applies to all), the invoker's company mandate, and the invoker's KT mandate. Notes if mandate has not yet been published (strat pool not locked). Shows full strat pool as context.
constraints: Returns error if campaign is not in ops phase or strat pool is not locked.

commands.name: /campaign-title
commands.description: Grant or revoke a narrative title for a kill team or company.

who_can_use.kt_title: Watch Captain or Watch Lieutenant (within their own company only)

parameters.name: target
parameters.type: user mention (KT: the Sgt | company: any member of the company)
parameters.description: The Sgt of the KT to title, or any member of the company to title.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: The title text to grant. Pass empty string or 'revoke' to strip the current title.

commands.bot_response: Confirms grant or revocation. Posts a public announcement embed in the channel noting the title (if this is a grant, not a revoke).
constraints: Grant requires target prestige to be above the floor: KT >= 250, company >= 500 (rolling 28-day window).
Grant cooldown: 7 calendar days since the granting authority last granted a title. Revocation has no cooldown.
Captain/LT may only title KTs within their own company.
If KT/company prestige drops below retain threshold (KT < 150, company < 300), bot auto-strips the title and posts a notice.

commands.name: /campaign-dashboard
commands.description: Post or refresh the campaign dashboard embed. Creates a persistent embed showing the full campaign state. Bot edits the existing message if one is already pinned in this channel.
commands.output: persistent (bot edits the embed in place on subsequent calls)
commands.bot_response: Posts or updates the campaign dashboard embed containing: beat number and status, ops window open/close times, committed planet and pressure, theatre strat mandate, terminus flag, lore priority KT and company, company prestige rankings with ribbons/titles/honours, KT prestige top-5. Bot also auto-refreshes the dashboard at beat close and beat resolution.
constraints: Only one dashboard embed per campaign. If bot finds an existing pinned dashboard message it edits rather than posting new.
Forgemaster must invoke this in the designated campaign channel.

commands.name: /campaign-status
commands.description: View the current campaign phase, beat schedule, and resolution state. Intended for WM and Forgemaster to check campaign admin status.
commands.bot_response: Shows campaign ID, current phase, current beat, all beat opens_at/closes_at/resolved_at timestamps, whether the strat pool is locked, whether cascade windows are open for each tier, and whether any auto-de-enlist warnings have been sent.

commands.name: /campaign-milestone
commands.description: View your personal milestone progress for the current campaign.
commands.bot_response: Shows all active milestone sets for the invoker's chapter. For each milestone: label, current count, threshold, completion status. Completed milestones show prestige awarded. Progress bars rendered with unicode block characters. Universal milestones always shown first, then chapter-affinity sets.

beat_resolution_sequence._note: What the bot does automatically at closes_at. No command triggers this — it runs on a scheduler.
steps: 1. Lock campaign_log — reject all new submissions until resolved_at is set.
2. Compute final prestige for all KTs and companies for this beat window.
3. Check and update all ribbon, title retention, honour, and lore priority thresholds.
4. Update home_chapter_rotation if lore priority KT changed.
5. Check milestone progress for all enlisted members and auto-award any newly completed milestones.
6. Compute pressure delta: base -1 if ops_run >= threshold (TBD), +1 if terminus kill made prestige, +2 if no ops run on node.
7. Archive beat state into campaign.beat_history as a beat_record.
8. If beat < 3: open next beat, set new opens_at/closes_at from beat_schedule, post beat open announcement.
9. If beat == 3: set campaign phase = evaluating, compute campaign outcome, post campaign resolution announcement.
